This article describes how to change the date or time of an event. If you need more information about creating a calendar and an event, please see the [[Work with events]] article.

= Change the date or time of an event =
*Locate the event you wish to edit in the appropriate calendar and right-click it.
*Choose the {menu Edit} option.
OR
*Select the event in the Event list and press {key Enter} on your keyboard.
Now edit as required.
*In the {pref From} and {pref To} fields, make the desired changes. Other fields may be changed as well if desired.
*Once all changes have been made, click the {button Save and Close} button.
Congratulations, the time or date of the event has been successfully changed.
